what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Uganda, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 48253 Somali refugees in Uganda, 5.4% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia from 1986 to 1996, in 2001 to 2002 and in every year from 2006 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
From 2006 the government's opponents it records include ARS/UIC, Al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1991 at 200 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 51192, at the end of 2022, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2016 and 2019 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Uganda.
These are year-end totals for Uganda only, reported to UNHCR.
